selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: original cmdline lacks audit=1, healthy boot identity captured
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change /proc/cmdline had no audit=1; boot_id 2fc81aed-3ce8-4a35-8f4c-b73206afa45f recorded as baseline boot identity

selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel parameter audit=1 added persistently via grubby to all boot entries
selected_evidence.summary: grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1 succeeded; grubby --info=ALL shows audit=1 appended to args for both the main and rescue kernel entries

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistence mechanism confirmed in grub.cfg and defaults
selected_evidence.summary: /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX updated to include audit=1; grep of /boot/grub2/grub.cfg confirms audit=1 present on linux16 lines for boot entries

selected_evidence.requirement: Reboot acknowledgement returns before disconnection (safe reboot mechanism)
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded delayed shell; exec call returned ACK_RETURNED immediately, before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart actually occurred (changed boot identity, not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id/cmdline (reboot pending); next poll timed out (node down mid-reboot); final poll succeeded with new boot_id 6967ac42-9c01-4a8c-ab56-54a8624acb5e, proving a genuine restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that audit=1 took effect on the running kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1; dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' and audit netlink socket initialization, confirming the kernel parameter was applied and the audit subsystem is active
